author: devo_tiger
body:
The Hybrid converts your normal attacks in to Hybrid attacks.

Hybrid damage scaling is sum of  x0.65 of attack + 0.65 of magic. So in balanced stat scenario it will add 35% damage. If you have only Attack or Magic on your weapon, you will end up doing less damage.
